decisions.assessment: Do not retain the old no-replacement-step premise as current. ADR1207 supersedes1069, and2549 makes the stated pair replace even a profile-backed default for DeviceRGB into DeviceCMYK. The source explicit functions and timing support this correction. Preserve ICCBased-target exclusion and caller-owned scope. Defaults are implementation choices, not a unique nominal-pair mandate.
decisions.assertions: transparency_groups::a_device_rgb_colour_into_the_output_intents_press_is_separated_by_the_stated_functions compares worked CMYK inks, requires unstated control to differ, and tests ICCBased control and inline image. a_device_rgb_group_into_the_output_intents_press_takes_the_pair_at_the_do checks independent inks and a differing unstated control. Nested ICCBased parent test explicitly permits a separate unsupported group report; it is not complete rendering proof.
